title: Part 2 : 2022: Methods for Determination of Viscsoity and Viscometric Fixed Points of Glass - Part 2 Determination of Softening Point
clause_1_scope: This standard (Part 2) prescribes the method of determining the softening point of glass.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Part 1 : 2022: Methods for Determination of Viscosity and Viscometric Fixed Points of Glass - Part 1 Standard Test Methods

clause_3_terminology: Part 2 : 2022: Methods for Determination of Viscsoity and Viscometric Fixed Points of Glass

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
